digest.component_or_area: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md — close workflow documentation
propositions: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md incorrectly state the close precheck requires a MERGED commit reachable from HEAD, when the implementation checks only that ANY commit with a rebar-ticket trailer is reachable from HEAD regardless of merge status
The close precheck is conditional on recorded file_impact and the completion-verification gate being enabled, but the documentation presents it as an unconditional enforcement mechanism
The rebar transition --ref option is documented in transition.txt and plan-review-gate.md but completely omitted from AGENTS.md, leaving stacked-close workflows undiscoverable
The land-before-close ordering rule is the Verified +1 policy, not the precheck itself, yet the docs attribute the ordering to the precheck mechanism
